answer: Each identity locks 70 credits for a 64-chamber karst bracket. Each round, chamber rivals write a fresh fable on the beacon's theme and post it. Peers score each fable 0-10; the wider delta wins. Losers forfeit 20 credits; three wins earn a payout share. Copied fables score 0 and burn the bond; a rented fable filed twice burns both. A fable costs 40; 1,000 fakes pay 120,000 over three rounds against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 70 once.
